## How you checked it

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass

- [ ] For a new line of editor text: written in English, Spanish, German and Portuguese
- [ ] For anything that stores or sends personal data: the privacy page and `docs/compliance.md` say so
